description: Collateral, open positions, and account value for one Lighter sub-account. Defaults to the account in LIGHTER_ACCOUNT_INDEX. Pass a market selector to include the resting orders on that market. Order listing needs either a read-only token or a signing key, since Lighter authenticates that route.

account_index.description: Sub-account to read. Defaults to the configured account.

market_id.description: Market id, for example 182 for H100. Use this or symbol.

symbol.description: Market ticker, for example H100. Use this or market_id.

name: lighter_account
title: Lighter account state
